findings.title: Resource count formatting is inconsistent within Admin (stats card & table footer omit the thousands separator; table header includes it)
reproSteps: Open /admin as admin
Read the 'Live Resources' stat card -> renders '1816'
Click the Resources tab; read the header description -> 'Manage all 1,993 resources in the database'
Read the pagination footer -> 'Showing 1 - 25 of 1993 resources'
findings.expected: All resource counts use one consistent number format (thousands separators applied everywhere, e.g. 1,816 / 1,993).
findings.actual: AdminStats card ('1816', ResourceManager footer '1993') omit the comma while the ResourceManager header ('1,993') includes it — code: AdminStats.tsx line 146 and ResourceManager.tsx line 1044 use raw values, line 672/673 uses .toLocaleString().

findings.title: Taxonomy 'Create category' dialog closes and discards typed input when server-side validation fails (empty / duplicate name / duplicate slug)
reproSteps: Open /admin?tab=categories
Click 'Add' (button-create-category)
Type name 'PersistTest' and slug 'encoding-codecs' (a slug already in use)
Click 'Create' (button-confirm-create)
findings.expected: A validation error is shown and the dialog stays open with the user's entered values so they can correct the offending field.
findings.actual: A destructive toast ('The slug "encoding-codecs" is already in use') flashes, but the create dialog closes immediately and all typed input is lost. Verified at t=100..2000ms the dialog and its inputs are gone. Same behavior for empty name/slug ('Name, Slug are required') and duplicate name ('A category named "Media Tools" already exists'). No category was actually created (count stayed 9).

findings.title: Taxonomy 'Edit category' dialog closes and discards edits when validation fails (empty name)
reproSteps: Open /admin?tab=categories
Click the pencil/edit button on any category row (e.g. button-edit-1091)
Clear the Name field
Click Save/Confirm
findings.expected: Validation error shown and the edit dialog stays open so the user can restore the name.
findings.actual: The edit dialog closes immediately (afterEmptySubmit dialog absent), discarding the in-progress edit; only a transient toast is shown. Reproduced on two consecutive attempts. Category name unchanged in DB (no data mutated).

findings.title: 'Rejected' stat deep-link produces a non-round-tripping URL; the rejected filter is lost on reload
reproSteps: Open /admin as admin
Click the '177 rejected' link (link-stat-rejected) on the Live Resources card
Observe Resources tab opens with status filter = Rejected, footer 'Showing 1 - 25 of 177 resources', URL becomes /admin#resources
Reload the page
findings.expected: The filtered state either persists on reload or the URL reflects it (e.g. /admin?tab=resources&status=rejected, which does work when typed directly).
findings.actual: After reload the Resources tab is active but the status filter resets to 'All Status' (footer jumps to 'Showing 1 - 25 of 1993 resources'). The deep-link sets ?status=rejected via replaceState but the subsequent onNavigate('resources') overwrites the URL to '#resources', dropping the param, so the filtered view cannot be reloaded, shared, or bookmarked. Reproduced twice.

findings.title: Resources table footer uses plural 'resources' when exactly one result matches ('Showing 1 - 1 of 1 resources')
reproSteps: Open /admin?tab=resources
Search 'js_mse_eme' (a single-match query) and press Enter
Read the pagination footer
findings.expected: Singular noun for one result, e.g. 'Showing 1 - 1 of 1 resource'.
findings.actual: Footer reads 'Showing 1 - 1 of 1 resources' (wrong plural). ResourceManager.tsx line 1044 hardcodes 'resources' with no count-aware pluralization. Reproduced with two different single-match queries (js_mse_eme, srtdroid).

findings.title: Resource edit dialog drops keyboard focus to <body> on close instead of returning it to the triggering row button
reproSteps: Open /admin?tab=resources
Click a row's edit button (e.g. button-edit-188015) — focus correctly moves into the dialog title field
Close the dialog via Escape (also reproduced via the Cancel button)
findings.expected: On close, focus returns to the edit button that opened the dialog (standard modal focus restoration) so keyboard/AT users keep their place in the table.
findings.actual: activeElement after close is document.body (isTrigger:false, isBody:true) for both Escape and Cancel paths. The shared single Dialog is not tied to a per-row trigger and has no onCloseAutoFocus restoration, so focus is lost. Reproduced 3x (esc, cancel, esc).

findings.title: Inconsistent validation-failure UX between admin dialogs: ResourceManager edit dialog stays open with an inline error, but taxonomy create/edit dialogs close and drop input
reproSteps: Open /admin?tab=resources, edit a resource, clear the Title, click Save -> inline error 'Title is required', dialog STAYS OPEN
Open /admin?tab=categories, add/edit a category, submit invalid -> toast error, dialog CLOSES and input is lost
findings.expected: Consistent validation-failure behavior across all admin dialogs (keep the dialog open and surface the error in-place).
findings.actual: ResourceManager edit dialog keeps the dialog open and shows a persistent inline field error; the GenericCrudManager taxonomy dialogs close on validation failure with only a transient toast, discarding the user's work. Two different, conflicting patterns for the same kind of interaction.

findings.title: Resources table row action buttons (edit/delete) are below the 44px touch-target width on mobile
reproSteps: Open /admin?tab=resources on a 375x667 mobile viewport (isMobile:true, hasTouch:true)
Scroll the table horizontally to the Actions column
Measure the edit and delete icon buttons' bounding boxes
findings.expected: Interactive touch targets are at least 44x44 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.5 / mobile HIG).
findings.actual: Edit button is 42x44 and Delete button is 40x44 — both narrower than 44px, so the tappable width falls under the recommended minimum on touch. Measured identically on two runs.
